info.brief: Functions and constants for interacting with Dear ImGUI
info.description: Functions and constants for interacting with Dear ImGUI

parameters.name: visible
parameters.doc: Optional; if omitted or nil, no close button is shown.

elements.name: imgui.begin_popup_context_item
elements.description:
BeginPopupContextItem.
If id is omitted, uses the last item ID (same as ImGui helper behavior). Lua - call with no arguments to use the last item; passing nil is not accepted.

parameters.name: id
parameters.doc: Optional; if omitted, uses the last item ID.

parameters.name: style_var
parameters.doc: Enum for the style to be pushed

parameters.name: value
parameters.doc: Number or vmath.vector3 specifying the value of the style var

parameters.name: count
parameters.doc: Number of style vars to pop; optional, defaults to 1
